description: Each GPU cloud's and marketplace's posted on-demand prices per GPU, as its page on the site shows them (lowest and highest that day, as posted, with the configuration of the lowest) and its average in the index, standardized to the GPU's benchmark contract so providers compare like for like. Give a provider (e.g. "CoreWeave", "RunPod") and/or a GPU; a provider outside the index (AWS, Azure, Google Cloud, Oracle and others) answers with its lowest posted price for each GPU, as the GPU's page lists it. For questions like "what does RunPod charge for an H100?", "AWS H100 price" or "Lambda GPU pricing".

provider.description: A provider's name or page id; omit for all providers.

name: get_provider_prices

other_posted_prices.description: With a GPU: the providers outside the index (the hyperscalers and others), each one's lowest on-demand price per GPU-hour as posted, not standardized, as the GPU's page lists them

gpu_page.description: The GPU's page, which lists this price under other posted prices

high_price.description: Highest posted price that day, USD per GPU-hour, as posted

index_average.description: This provider's average in the index, standardized to the benchmark contract

low_price.description: Lowest posted price that day, USD per GPU-hour, as posted

posted_eur.description: The price as posted, in euros, when the provider posts in euros

read_at.description: When its prices were last read (the GPU page's As of)

outside_index.description: A provider outside the index: its lowest posted prices, not standardized

read_from.description: The hosts its prices are read from, as its page says

title: GPU prices by provider
